story.title: Apple will have limited iPhone Duo units available in stores on Friday - Reuters

facts.text: Apple says it will have “limited” iPhone Duo models for sale in stores, according to a report from Reuters.
“On Friday morning, our teams look forward ​to welcoming customers at Apple Stores to experience iPhone Duo ​and the incredible iPhone line-up for themselves,” Apple said in a statement to Reuters.
The iPhone Duo is Apple’s first foldable, offering a 5.4-inch outer display and 7.6-inch inner screen.
Apple didn’t immediately respond to The Verge’s request for comment.
It starts at $1,999, and recent reports have suggested that the company might not have enough to make available in stores on a walk-in basis due to supply constraints.
Apple Will Have 'Limited' IPhone Duo Units Available in Stores on Friday
The new foldable iPhone Duo is on display during Apple's event at the Steve Jobs Theater in Cupertino, California, U.S.
“On Friday morning, our teams look forward to welcoming customers at Apple Stores to experience iPhone Duo and the incredible iPhone line-up for themselves," Apple said in a statement.

SAN FRANCISCO, Oct 21 (Reuters) - Apple on Wednesday said it will have 'limited' numbers of its folding iPhone Duo phone available for walk-in customers when the device launches Friday, after initial online orders sold out in minutes and pushed delivery times for some customers to January.
The new foldable iPhone Duo is on display during Apple's event at the Steve Jobs Theater in Cupertino, California, U.S.
The availability of walk-in units will vary by country, Apple said.
Online order pickup and limited walk-in purchases will be available in the United States, Australia, Canada, Mexico and much of the UK and Europe.

Apple announced its first folding phone in September, with analysts expecting it to quickly come to dominate a niche segment where rivals such as Samsung Electronics and Huawei Technologies have sold premium offerings for years.

"Apple Stores will have limited iPhone Duo available for walk-in customers, and we're working hard to get this revolutionary new product into customers' hands as quickly as possible." The availability of walk-in units will vary by country, Apple said.
But the iPhone Duo is also a more complex product than standard candy-bar iPhones, with a tight-fitting hinge that analysts believe may take time for Apple to learn to manufacture in high volumes.

Apple announced its first folding phone in September, with analysts expecting it to quickly come to dominate a niche segment where rivals such as Samsung Electronics and Huawei Technologies have sold premium offerings for years.
Online order pickup and limited walk-in purchases will be available in the United States, Australia, Canada, Mexico and much of the UK and Europe.
Those include mainland China, France, Hong Kong, India, Japan, Malaysia, South Korea, Taiwan, Thailand and the UAE, Apple said.
